newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca sees answer to FDA warning late March.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca sees answer to FDA warning late March.

text.p: Zeneca Group Plc said on Tuesday it hoped to answer "outstanding issues" with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) over its northern England manufacturing site by the end of March.
Last month, the FDA issued a warning letter to Zeneca over a sterlile manufacturing area at its Macclesfield site, which makes prostate cancer drug Zoladex.
Chief executive David Barnes told a news conference the FDA had acknowledged in its letter that most of its concerns had already been dealt with or were being dealt with.
"We are confident that the few remaining, outstanding issues are one which we can resolve to the FDA's total satisfaction," said Barnes.

He added the site had successfuly undergone 20 inspections over the past 12 months and noted there had been "no problem with Zoladex. There has been no recall and no interruption of supply to markets, including the U.S."
